name: antigrative-dashboard-ide
description: Adaptive throughput, cache and context icons with local token usage charts in the Antigravity IDE Agent composer.

commands.title: Antigrative Dashboard: Repair IDE Launch Flags

antigrativeDashboard.ide.enabled.description: Enable the standalone Antigravity IDE composer integration. Start the IDE with the loopback debugging flags described in the README.

antigrativeDashboard.ide.autoConfigureLa.description: How to repair Antigravity IDE shortcuts/launchers when loopback debugging flags are missing or cleared by an IDE update.

antigrativeDashboard.ide.remoteSsh.description: Allow Remote-SSH IDE windows to discover remote agy/language_server credentials via non-interactive ssh -o BatchMode=yes.
